visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A baseball pitcher in a blue uniform with the number 59 throws a ball toward home plate from the mound, viewed through a green safety net in the foreground. The camera then tilts upward to reveal a wide shot of the baseball stadium interior, including the outfield, illuminated scoreboards, and rows of spectators in the stands. (2) The scene transitions to a medium close-up interview with a young man wearing a blue Chinese Taipei baseball jersey and matching cap. He speaks animatedly with subtle facial expressions and head movements while standing in front of the illuminated baseball field at night. An arm holding a smartphone is partially visible on the right side of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 火影忍者配樂🥷. (2) [Subtitle]: 登板的時候是火影忍者的應援曲. 那那首歌你覺得選他有什麼特別的意義嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 我在黑山羊訓練. 我跟致榮都是用那個. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後我們會有一個墊步丟的練習. 練習就是需要突破自己最快的球速. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們都會放那首歌. 然後放那首歌的時候都會. (6) [Subtitle]: 超過就是原本自己的速度. (7) [Subtitle]: 你像火影忍者裡面的哪個角色嗎. (8) [Subtitle]: 就是主角吧. 鳴人. (9) [Subtitle]: 我覺得他就是很有自信的一個人.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy Japanese anime-style rock music begins with a fast-paced drum rhythm and a sharp, piercing flute melody accompanied by distorted electric guitar chords. The track has a high arousal level and a minor-mode tonality, maintaining a constant technical density with no human speech. (2) A male interviewer's voice enters, speaking with a polite and questioning tone over the ongoing music, which is now ducked to a lower background volume. A second male voice, the primary speaker, responds with a clear, steady, and positive vocal profile, explaining his training routines. The music continues to drive the energy of the segment through its rhythmic percussion and melodic woodwind layers.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to highlight the personal story of a baseball player's entrance/training music, linking professional sports performance with pop culture (Naruto anime) to engage fans and provide behind-the-scenes insight into the athlete's motivation and training methods.
